content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Autoplay keeps serving videos on topics I’m about to think. The timing is eerie.
Autoplay chains from the current video’s tags and your watch history. Were those topics adjacent to what you’d just viewed or searched?
I had watched a related clip earlier in the day.
That linkage is typical. Testing from a logged-out session or a new profile can show how much of the effect comes from history vs. general popularity.
Logged-out recommendations are different for me.
That difference points to account-based signals. A short note of title chains can help illustrate how one topic leads into the next.
I’ll map a chain or two.
